title: DevOps Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from Linux, networking and programming fundamentals into cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability and reliability engineering.

facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and ending around 2030.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build Linux, networking, Git, scripting, cloud, containers and CI/CD competence with deployable infrastructure projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Develop depth in cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, platform engineering or SRE.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Own production platforms, reliability, security, observability and infrastructure architecture.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine infrastructure expertise with cloud economics, security, AI-enabled operations and technical leadership.

blocks.label: 4-year honours variant
blocks.text: Use the additional academic depth for distributed systems, cloud security, advanced networking, an extended infrastructure project, research or an industry internship.

rows.text: Terraform, cloud APIs, policy, configuration management
CI/CD, cloud security, secrets, vulnerability management

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Keep Linux, networking, distributed systems and automation as the foundation. Cloud products will change, but infrastructure principles, reliability, security, observability and infrastructure-as-code practices transfer across platforms.

blocks.text: Requirements vary by employer. Check current postings before choosing AWS/Azure/GCP or a specific Kubernetes/IaC stack.

rows.text: Eligible bachelor's graduates under current rules

blocks.label: PMRF
blocks.text: Applies to eligible PhD candidates through specified institutional and academic pathways; it is not a general undergraduate scholarship.

blocks.label: Fulbright-Nehru Master's
blocks.text: Requires a bachelor's with at least 55% and three years of full-time paid work, plus other requirements. USIEF Fulbright-Nehru Master's

blocks.label: DAAD master's
blocks.text: Requirements vary by programme. The supplied planning benchmark is approximately 7.5/10 CGPA or higher, English/German B2, with two years' work experience preferred. DAAD India

blocks.label: Sponsorship note
blocks.text: University scholarships, external fellowships and employer sponsorship have separate eligibility rules; verify each independently.

blocks.label: Visa and job-offer note
blocks.text: Admission, scholarships, student visas and post-study work rights are separate matters. Verify the destination's current immigration rules for the intended intake.
Typical years vary by employer and individual progression.

Senior infrastructure work increasingly combines reliability, security, automation, cloud economics and architecture. Maintain strong Linux, networking and distributed-systems fundamentals while adapting to new cloud platforms, platform-engineering practices and AI-assisted operations.
